title: Figma Design Context
description: Canonical shape for products/<slug>/BRD/figma/figma-context.json — the normalized output of design-reference-engine/figma-reference.md's extraction technique. A raw Figma MCP tool response is never stored as-is; it is always normalized into this shape first. Every leaf value under tokens/components/layouts/responsive/interactions/visual-rules carries its own confidence tag — this is not a convention left to prose, it is structurally required below.

confidence.description: explicit = read directly from Figma's own structured data (a bound variable, a named variant, an auto-layout property). inferred = a reasonable reading from visual inspection with no bound structural data behind it. assumed = no signal at all; a Design-Glanza default was used. Matches the Explicit/Inferred/Assumed vocabulary used everywhere else in this engine (Rule 10) — no new tagging scheme.

sourceRef.description: Figma node/variable/style id or name this value was read from, when confidence is explicit or inferred. Omitted when confidence is assumed (there is no Figma source to cite).

inspectionMode.description: structured = the Figma Skill's inspection tool returned real structural data (layers/variables/components/auto-layout). image-fallback = structural inspection was unavailable or failed; extraction fell back to reference-analysis.md's image-only technique (figma-reference.md's TODO-4 procedure). This field is the single switch product-intelligence/brd-analysis.md's confidence rule checks.

fallbackReason.description: Required when inspectionMode is image-fallback — why structured inspection was unavailable (auth failure, tool unavailable, permission denied, file structure not inspectable). Never left blank when inspectionMode is image-fallback — a fallback is always recorded, never silent.

exportedImagePath.description: Relative path under BRD/figma/screens/, e.g. screens/dashboard.png. Omitted if inspectionMode is structured-only with no export performed.

role.description: What this frame is for, e.g. 'closest existing analogue to the new screen requirement' — used by visual-benchmark.md to pick the Reference-column asset.

colors.description: Semantic + raw swatches, by Figma variable collection + mode (light/dark). Each leaf is a valueWithConfidence.

typography.description: Family, scale steps, weights, line-height, pairing. Each leaf is a valueWithConfidence.

spacing.description: Base unit and step scale. Each leaf is a valueWithConfidence.

radius.description: Radius scale, per-component-type mapping if present. Each leaf is a valueWithConfidence.

elevation.description: Shadow steps and usage mapping. Each leaf is a valueWithConfidence.

sizing.description: Control sizes, icon sizes, breakpoint widths. Each leaf is a valueWithConfidence.

matchedRegistryEntry.description: component-registry/* entry name this maps to, per figma-reference.md's mapping table, or null if genuinely no match (Rule 24 still applies — logged, never silent).

mappedState.description: The ux-engine/state-design.md mandatory-state name this variant maps to (initial/loading/success/empty/validation error/system error/permission denied/processing/completed/cancelled/conflict/timeout/offline), where mappable.

adaptationDecision.description: One of ui-engine/responsive-system.md's seven named adaptation decisions, where inferable from a distinct breakpoint frame actually present in the Figma file.
